mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name, e.mobile, e.job_type, e.status, a.clock_in_at, a.clock_out_at, r.report_at AS last_report_at, r.content AS last_report_content FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN hr_attendance a ON a.employee_id = e.id AND a.work_date = #{today} LEFT JOIN hr_route_report r ON r.id = ( SELECT rr.id FROM hr_route_report rr WHERE rr.employee_id = e.id ORDER BY rr.report_at DESC, rr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = #{status} ORDER BY e.id
